title: Your First Real Song
body: This is "Mary Had a Little Lamb" — one of the oldest piano teaching pieces. Simple, but it contains everything: stepwise motion, a repeated note, and a satisfying return to the tonic C.

title: The Opening Phrase
caption: E D C D — the melody descends from E to C, then bounces back to D. This is a pickup phrase: it creates gentle tension that the next bar resolves. Listen for the "Mary had a..." rhythm.
